scope: Analytic premise audit and read-only aggregate/hash inspection. No person-level array, new fit, rerun, threshold change or post hoc approval of failed units.
old_control_rule: Fit LR to group-size-preserving shuffled ATTACK_TRAIN SEX labels, predict on INNER_SELECTION view, score against true INNER_SELECTION SEX as max(AUC, 1-AUC), require <=0.60.
counterexample: If a disclosed one-dimensional feature equals true SEX, many correctly shuffled ATTACK_TRAIN label permutations yield a nonzero fitted LR coefficient. For any such coefficient, its held-out score ranks the feature forward or backward. Scored against true INNER_SELECTION SEX, max(AUC,1-AUC)=1 in either case. The mandatory <=0.60 rule can therefore fail under a correct shuffle and correct evaluator; its null premise is false.
interpretation: The counterexample establishes a defect in the control's claimed null, not that either observed failure is harmless or that either candidate's privacy result passes. A high old shuffled AUC can arise from actual sensitive structure in the transmitted view despite correctly shuffled fit labels. The full-view fresh readers already measure that structure separately.
recommended_prospective_amendment: Preserve all old reports and FAIL statuses. Before any replacement-control work, S1 should freeze and push a dated protocol with new probe IDs and charged fits. Continue to report shuffled-ATT/true-INNER AUC descriptively. For a mandatory null, score the shuffled-fit predictions against an independently group-size-preserving shuffled INNER_SELECTION SEX vector fixed before candidate outcomes, or use a fixed group-permutation null distribution. Keep constant/null and planted-leak controls, exact row/view custody and source-label-use checks. Apply the new rule to all candidate and matched control arms under a common version; do not silently grandfather old PASS reports.
unrelated_work: Unrelated prelocked units may continue under the unchanged original evaluator and their own recorded gates while S1 decides a prospective amendment. Original failures cannot enter an old-protocol competitive pass.
